flush_interval.description: Set an interval of seconds before to flush records to a destination

daemon_mode.description: Instruct Fluent Bit to run in foreground or background mode.

log_level.description: Set the verbosity level of the service (error, warning, info, debug, trace)

plugins_file_path.description: Specify an optional 'Plugins' configuration file to load external plugins

http_server_enabled.description: Enable/Disable the built-in HTTP Server for metrics

http_listen_addr.description: Address to listen for the HTTP Server metrics endpoint

http_server_port.description: Port for the built-in HTTP Server for metrics

input_cpu_interval.description: Read interval in seconds for the CPU input plugin
